W.note: Clean teal-accented two-column layout with the cart beside the grid, real quantity and remove controls and an Added state, though the gradient initial tiles and generic chrome feel template-like.

X.note: Restrained line-art products with real variant radios, sold-out and error handling, but equal-height cards leave large empty bottoms and the cart sits far below the grid on desktop.

Y.note: Tidy grey line-art cards with size chips and Save links, but the three-column grid leaves the right side empty and the bag sits far below the products, so the purchase loop is weaker.

Z.note: The most complete shopping job: header cart badge, sticky cart with steppers, free-shipping bar and totals, stock-aware Only N left and Sold out states, though the 4-up cards cramp titles and the copy adds some clutter.
